I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

I couldn't check the date. None of the shared files I can see list a renewal date for Brackenwater; the North cheat sheet mentions the account but gives no renewal date. I also have nowhere of my own to save the note, so her message in #north-team is the record.

As she asked, I did nothing else.
